name: KreaLand
description: NOTE : Showcase images were created with ComfyUI and are in PNG, include metadata & workflow. If you download the workflows (.json) from my images and they don't work on your setup, please understand that I likely won't be able to help you. I'm sorry, but I simply don't have the time to respond to the many requests I receive. A few tips: - If you are new to ComfyUI, it's best to avoid using my workflows. It's not that they are overly complicated, but they do require a solid foundational understanding. - My workflows are quite resource-intensive to run (I use a 5090 / 32GB VRAM / 64GB RAM); if your config is limited, performance will be slow, even if they do run. - If you encounter unrecognized nodes, try replacing them with core nodes or deleting them if they aren't essential.
